content_blocks.label: clause_1._Testamentary_Intent
content_blocks.text: I, Robert M. Black, of Greenfield City, State of Verano, do hereby make, publish, and declare this my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I give and bequeath all of my personal property to my spouse, Sarah L. Black, free and clear of any encumbrances.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Real_Property
content_blocks.text: I give and bequeath to my son, John M. Black, all of my real property located at 123 Main Street, Greenfield City, State of Verano.
